does: Adds a roll stream of a type to the roll manager: the manager's last stream id plus one becomes the stream's id, the base seed plus that id its seed, its count zero; sets the manager's HasChanges.

evidence.says: GK.Memory.Watch on the roll manager's +0x18 (the last stream id) over the first dialogue check: one change 1->2 written at +0x309FD9E, and the new Dialog stream read seed = base seed + 2 with id 2 (Generic: id 1, seed base+1); same shape as EoCServer.dll esv::roll::stream::RollManager::CreateStream
A write watch on the roll manager's last stream id shows 1 to 2 at +0x309FD9E inside this function over the first dialogue check; the Dialog stream then reads the base seed plus 2
The new stream's id is the last id plus one, its seed the base seed plus that id, its count 0
